name: Tentacruel (CobbleEffort form)
look: a big deep-sea squid: a long purple mantle with two fins and glowing blue ring photophores, great slit-pupilled yellow eyes, eight arms with glowing blue tips and two long tentacles with hooked clubs
entry: A giant of the abyss. The tips of its eight arms glow like a swarm of fireflies to dazzle its prey, and it seizes it with the dark hooks on its tentacle clubs. Its eyes are the largest of any Pokémon that lives in the sea.
how: Wild: rare in the depths of deep oceans (in the dark, far below the surface).
